config.comment.autocleartrash: Open the trash GUI and discard all items after a refresh message.
config.comment.pointbuyerenabled: Run /botmanager buy once every 60 seconds in the background.
config.comment.autoenableflightdevice: Take out and enable the Infinite Flight Device after joining or changing dimensions.
config.comment.pointsperpurchase: The quantity passed to each botmanager buy command.
config.comment.cleartrashhotkey: Open the trash GUI and clear it immediately.
config.comment.openconfighotkey: Open the TrashCan Detector configuration screen.
config.comment.enableflightdevicehotkey: Immediately try to enable the Infinite Flight Device.
config.comment.clearmode: Choose clear all, exclude the blacklist, or clear only the whitelist.
config.comment.directtrashdiscard: When enabled, discard directly from trash slots; when disabled, move to the inventory first.
config.comment.clearblacklist: Item IDs excluded from clearing, one per line.
config.comment.clearwhitelist: Only these item IDs are cleared, one per line.
config.comment.synctweakeroomininglist: Use Tweakeroo's block mining restriction list as a clear filter.
config.comment.syncprintermininglist: Use Litematica Printer Hana's excavation list as a clear filter.
